answer: Each identity holds one unique 1 GB encrypted vault shard and must answer random retrieval challenges every epoch. A farm cannot share one copy: challenges are per-shard and concurrent, so 100 fakes need 100 GB plus a $5 bond each, slashed on any miss. A plume of spot-checks fans out each epoch and hollow copies fail instantly, so cost per fake rises with storage and latency as the farm grows.
